notes.title: Pandemic Train update! Voice-overs, and 2 new languages
notes.notes:
Welcome survivors!

We're thrilled to announce a fresh update for Pandemic Train, packed with fantastic additions to enhance your gaming experience. In response to the enthusiastic feedback from our global community, we've incorporated two new languages into the game: Ukrainian and Italian! Now, players can dive into the thrilling world of Pandemic Train in even more linguistic flavors.

But that's not all! We've also introduced voice-over support in English, bringing an extra layer of immersion to your gameplay. Whether you're strategizing your next move or unraveling the mysteries of the pandemic, let the captivating voices guide you through the journey.

And now you can buy a ticket for this train 25% discounted!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/97eab2dee35cd0355bfd8142d36fdb3c0b86709a.png

What next?

But hold on tight, because there's more excitement on the horizon! Brace yourselves for a massive upcoming update, set to revolutionize your Pandemic Train adventure. 


All aboard for adventure and excitement – Pandemic Train is rolling into new territories, and we invite you to join us on this thrilling ride! 


[expand type=details]

 Adding English Voice-Overs
 Adding Italian language
 Adding the Ukrainian language
 Fixing minor bugs

[/expand]

notes.title: Pandemic Train - Game's Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
Attention, Survivors!

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the first update for Pandemic Train, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can expect:

New Salesman Kulson:
Meet Kulson, a new vendor who will appear in locations different than those with the Bone Collector. Kulson offers unique goods and items to help you on your Pandemic Train adventure. Be ready for exciting new offerings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/03e07b13fc1e08591f469ecb1dc3453f3642eb52.png

Travel Innovation - "Jump" to selected locations:
Harness the power of metacurrency to leap to your chosen destination! With the latest update, Kovalsky's happy to smuggle you and your crew, enabling strategic movements from HQ across the map… if only you have some extra metacurrency to offer him in exchange. Plan your routes wisely and stay one step ahead of the pandemic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/bc0ae12e4c93e8e2436e39aa9944be2b5945177e.png

Persistent Train Modules:
Your train is now more resilient than ever! After facing the challenges of the pandemic head-on, your train's modules will remain intact upon your return to headquarters or even after unfortunate incidents resulting in the loss of a life. Keep building and fortifying your train for the ultimate pandemic survival.

Module Schematics Remain After Death:
Fear not, engineers! In the face of adversity, your hard-earned module schematics will persist even in the event of death. Your knowledge and progress are not lost, ensuring a more rewarding and strategic gameplay experience.

Get ready to dive back into the world of Pandemic Train with these awaited by you features! We appreciate your dedication to the game and hope these enhancements add a new layer of excitement to your railroading adventures.

More changes and improvements made can be found in the changelog:

Changelog
[expand type=details]

Added:

 - After death or returning to HQ, modules built on the train remain.
 - After death, schematics of modules purchased remain, including when returning to Headquarters and completing a Run.
 - We added the ability to "jump" to a location of your choice for a metavalue (after reaching a minimum of the third location).
 - We added a new salesman - Kulson on maps without Bone Collector
 - We added the possibility to skip the tutorial on the train
 - We added a button to change the camera angle on the train

Changed:
 - We improved the Balance related to the mechanics update

Fixed:
 - Fixed dialog display for 21:9 and 16:10 screens 
 - Fixed a reported bug of snipers not firing a bullet on the first shot
 

[/expand]

Stay vigilant, stay strategic, and keep the pandemic at bay!

The Pandemic Train Development Team

notes.notes:
Dear survivors!

As you well know, we are actively listening to your suggestions and feedback and are in the process of working on gameplay improvements. Your input is extremely valuable to us, and we appreciate the time and effort you have taken to share your thoughts with us.

We understand that the community plays an important role in shaping the future of our game, and we want to assure you that we are working diligently to address your concerns and make changes that will improve the overall game experience.

The power of cooperation between players and developers is enormous, and together we can create a more enjoyable and satisfying game environment. Your ideas and suggestions guide us on this journey, and we are excited about the improvements ahead.

Thank you for your continued support and for being a vital part of our gaming community. We look forward to sharing more updates and changes in the near future. Stay tuned!

[/expand]

 Voiceovers
 Support for the wider screens
 Rebinding keys
 Tutorial improvements

notes.title: Pandemic Train - Release date update
notes.notes:
Dear Passengers,
We're so happy to see you with us on September the 1st. For some people, it's the beginning of the autumn. For others, the most eventful time of the year as more and more games keeps releasing and finally taking up all of your free time. For us, it's exiting because we're closer and closer to Pandemic Train's launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/9c280a5f4df5d3b77dcca017286f80520894f347.png

Pandemic Train's release date
As some of you might have noticed, the launch date changed from Q3 to Q4. In real, it will be a couple of additional weeks, as we're polishing the game, translating it into several languages, and keep finding things that will help us address the most mentioned issues of the second beta test round. Therefore, we won't make it with releasing the game in September, but you won't have to wait much longer. Just give it a couple of more weeks. We hope you will like the results and improvements we got done in this time.
This being said, you can expect Pandemic Train to release in October 2023 🙂 More details coming soon!

Pandemic Train & Youtubers
Soon, we will post a special sign-up form for all Youtubers and Twitchers willing to stream Pandemic Train, prepare video materials for the game and spread the word about it. Make sure to stay on track with all the news and follow the game via the Steam Page to not miss any new updates.

Tip for your autumn:
Always look for the bright light at the end of the (train) tunnel, folks!
Pandemic Train team

notes.title: Beta tests finish & Release date update
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,
As you know, two weeks ago, we launched beta tests of Pandemic Train! Thanks to all who found some time to play and leave your feedback! Many of your comments opened our eyes to some of the game's problems and things that need to be fixed before its release. Therefore...

Pandemic Train will arrive a bit later
We want to address many of your notes and complaints. You've pointed out some stuff about combat that worried us greatly, as well as asked for more train management. We need to think it through and work out some new systems. Pandemic Train is supposed to engage you on many levels, and we don't want to destroy that element by releasing this game too early. That's why we've decided to move its launch a bit. We'll try our best to release the game in 2023, however, we want to give you the best possible game and your feedback shows us there's still a lot of room for improvement.

Thank you for all this feedback! 
In April, we will contact the authors of the most valuable feedback from beta tests and reward you with free game keys! Meanwhile, we're going back to work. Expect more news from us in the upcoming weeks.

Motivational quote for today:
Even in the darkest tunnel, always head toward the light!

Best regards,
Pandemic Train team

notes.title: Let's talk Pandemic Train: Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/d02301a95d72f234c4baada74c26dfbdab5cda6b.jpg

Hello passengers. You may have already noticed that the  demo is no longer available  ,but don't worry, you will still have a chance to play Pandemic train before its release (more on that below) 
 Your feedback has allowed us to look at our game from a different perspective and thanks to that we are making changes to the game which should please most of you. So we have some information about our progress for you!

As we wrote in our previous vlog, the issue of loot from our opponents has been discussed on our discord server. So YES!  We add loot to the game.  But this is not the end, not only will you be able to collect ammo, scrap and other resources but even the entire body of the enemy! 

Another new feature will be the  medical wagon! 
And this is where the bodies of your enemies will go

That would be enough of our announcements of changes and innovations.

Just one more thing.  We are planning play-tests!  So keep an eye on our social media, steam and discord for announcements! 

Bye! Until next time ;)
